packet.claim: The input grammar rejects a reply that contains an earlier fenced JSON object and a later fenced float, even though recover_json_object is specified to pass over the float and recover the earlier object.
packet.execution_evidence: executed: INVALID_INSTANTIATION; detail: the rewritten text is no cell of the grammar
packet.expected: recover_json_object returns the earlier fenced JSON object {"a":1} because the last fenced block is a float, which is not scoreable and is passed over.
packet.observed: The test harness reports INVALID_INSTANTIATION with detail 'the rewritten text is no cell of the grammar', so no recovery result is produced.
packet.scope: replies with a fenced JSON object followed by a later fenced non-object scalar such as a float
packet.source_basis: The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one... A candidate that parses as strict JSON, or as JSON with repeated keys resolved last-wins, is scoreable; one that does not (a float, for instance) is passed over, so a final answer refused for a float loses to an earlier draft that parsed (``docs/kernel.md``, P-06).
packet.uncertainty: The failure is reported by the grammar/instantiation layer, not by recover_json_object itself; it is unclear whether recover_json_object would return the earlier object if invoked directly on the text.
